versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "max" skill.

- Registers the "Max" skill for organizing public information from the Max video platform.
- Supports extraction of membership details, content channels, creator info, and help resources from public pages.
- Focuses on summarizing visible content, membership options, creator rules, and support links.
- Clearly excludes account sharing, bypassing copyright, membership trading, backend access, or any non-public data.
- Emphasizes compliance with platform policies and handling of market-specific variations in content and membership offers.
